instruction:
Software launch locations: LibreCAD: `/usr/bin/librecad`; FreeCAD: `/usr/bin/freecad`; KiCad: `/home/user/Applications/kicad-10.0.2/kicad-10.0.2-x86_64.AppImage`; Blender: `/home/user/Applications/blender-4.2.3-linux-x64/blender`. Required four-software transfer workflow: LibreCAD -> FreeCAD -> KiCad -> Blender. Start from the provided seed DXF /home/user/Desktop/seed_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf; do not start from a blank or unrelated drawing. This is a chained workflow: every later stage must read an artifact from the previous stage, and every required intermediate file must be saved on the Desktop. The design token for this task is EW4G07; keep this token visible in the DXF labels and KiCad silkscreen. The Blender output must visibly consume the stage-2 STL and stage-3 SVG through Blender's native import/export operations.

Design goal: Single-board-computer HAT mount plate with GPIO and camera clearance. This case is intentionally different from the other benchmark cases: domain=sbc_expansion_mount, mechanical target=an exploded mount scene showing brass standoffs and GPIO/header alignment, electronics target=a HAT-style PCB with GPIO40 header, camera keepout, EEPROM, I2C header, and power input.

1. LibreCAD stage: open the provided seed file /home/user/Desktop/seed_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf in LibreCAD, use it as the starting drawing, complete the required 2D geometry, remove all GUIDE construction entities, and save /home/user/Desktop/stage1_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf. Use millimeters. Use layers OUTLINE, KEEP_OUT, HOLE, LABEL. The overall drawing envelope must be 85 mm x 65 mm. Include the required circular features: center (7,7) radius 2.75; center (78,7) radius 2.75; center (7,58) radius 2.75; center (78,58) radius 2.75; center (42.5,32.5) radius 3. Draw two separate closed positive-area KEEP_OUT regions inside the outline: one containing the GPIO40 label and one containing the CAM label. Add readable labels EW4G07, GPIO40, CAM, I2C on the LABEL layer.
2. FreeCAD stage: import /home/user/Desktop/stage1_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf in FreeCAD. Create the 3D mechanical body from that LibreCAD DXF, including real clearance openings from both submitted KEEP_OUT regions, and export the body as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate.stl with an approximate bounding size of 85 mm x 65 mm x 12 mm. Then, from the same FreeCAD model, export a top-face or board-interface outline for KiCad as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate_handoff_outline.dxf. This handoff DXF must represent the same XY envelope as the FreeCAD body and include the visible labels FREECAD_TO_KICAD and EW4G07.
3. KiCad stage: open KiCad and import the complete /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate_handoff_outline.dxf onto Dwgs.User so the FreeCAD outline and labels remain available. Create one aligned 85 mm x 65 mm closed Edge.Cuts outline from the imported outer boundary, and save /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board.kicad_pcb. Add native footprints J1 (GPIO40, 40 pads), J2 (I2C, 4 pads), U1 (EEPROM, 8 pads), and J3 (power input, 2 pads), with all footprints inside the board. Add one positive-area camera rule-area keepout on F.Cu that overlaps the submitted CAM KEEP_OUT region. Add actual F.SilkS text carrying KICAD_TO_BLENDER, EDGE_FROM_STAGE2_HANDOFF, the stage2 handoff filename, EW4G07, GPIO40-J1, CAM-KEEP, I2C-J2, EEPROM-U1, and PWR-J3. Then use KiCad's Plot workflow to create /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board_profile.svg from only the same Edge.Cuts outline.
4. Blender stage: open Blender. Import /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate.stl with File > Import > STL, then import /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board_profile.svg with File > Import > Scalable Vector Graphics (.svg). Keep both imports as visible, mesh-bound geometry at the same 85 mm x 65 mm XY scale. Build an exploded mount scene with four distinct brass-colored standoff meshes aligned to the four corner holes and visible GPIO40/header alignment geometry. Export glTF Binary (.glb) through Blender's GUI as /home/user/Desktop/stage4_sbc_hat_mount_plate.glb. Do not use names or custom metadata as a substitute for visible geometry.

Required deliverables on the Desktop: /home/user/Desktop/stage1_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate.stl, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate_handoff_outline.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board.kicad_pcb, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board_profile.svg, /home/user/Desktop/stage4_sbc_hat_mount_plate.glb.

[Software] Use LibreCAD first, then FreeCAD, then KiCad, then Blender. Do not skip stages, reorder stages, or recreate the final result in only one software package.
